prompt.text:
Implement `split_compound(text, terms)` in `solution.py`.

`text` must be a string containing only lowercase ASCII letters. `terms` must be an iterable of non-empty strings, each also containing only lowercase ASCII letters. Raise `TypeError` when these outer types are invalid and `ValueError` when any string violates the character or non-empty rules. A one-shot iterable for `terms` must be supported.

Return every way to split all of `text` into terms from `terms`. Each result must be a tuple of strings, and the outer result must be sorted lexicographically with duplicates removed. Terms may be reused. Return `[()]` for empty `text`, and return `[]` when a non-empty string has no complete split. Do not mutate or return aliases to supplied containers.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
